issue.title: MysqlMutex using DB-Expressions in param binding

repository.name: yii2
repository.description: Yii 2: The Fast, Secure and Professional PHP Framework

issue.body:
### What steps will reproduce the problem?

Use `MysqlMutex` without a `keyPrefix`

### What is the expected result?

Mutex names prefixed with database name.

### What do you get instead?

Literal prefix for every mutex `DATABASE()....`

Default prefixes were introduced in https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/pull/19603/files
Related issue: https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/issues/19316

AFAIK param binding does not work when using an expression as the param value.
Maybe we could use a hash of the DSN instead?

There's even a test for expressions: https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/pull/19603/files#diff-03b85638c9569a6ea11d1599940f6fd0a87ef06c60942f9a9e43644c9c66a650R63-R64
But the expressions are also different as strings.

If Expressions as params would work; there should be a test with two Expressions `1+1` and `1*2` to see if both evaluate to `2`.

### Additional info

| Q                | A
| ---------------- | ---
| Yii version      | 2.0.47
| PHP version      | 8.x
| Operating system | Debian (Docker)

CC: @rob006 @samdark @kamarton @sanwv @handcode @eluhr @amk0
